assertions.description: window.DecisionModel exists as the Decisions API entry point (proposed IDL: [Exposed(Window AIDecisionModelAPI)]). Honest fail on every build without the developer-trial implementation.
DecisionModel.availability is a static method for side-effect-free readiness checks.
DecisionModel.create is a static method that builds a session (download-gated on user activation).
Sessions expose decide() for single-pass evaluation and destroy() for explicit cleanup.
assertions.test: typeof DecisionModel === 'function' && typeof DecisionModel.prototype.decide === 'function' && typeof DecisionModel.prototype.destroy === 'function'

assertions.description: Sessions expose a read-only PerformancePreference attribute named preference (IDL in review, CL 8499040).
availability() with a minimal boolean-question schema resolves to one of the four documented Built-in AI availability states.
assertions.test: (async () => { const r = await DecisionModel.availability({ expectedInputs: [{ type: 'text', languages: ['en'] }], questions: [{ id: 'probe', type: 'boolean', prompt: 'Is this input a question?' }] }); return ['unavailable', 'downloadable', 'downloading', 'available'].includes(r); })()
